messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: ggplot2 users survey
parts:
Hi all,

One of the thing I'm most proud about ggplot2 is you guys - the
ggplot2 community. I think the ggplot2 mailing list is one of the most
vibrant and useful visualisation communities on the web, and it adds a
huge amount to ggplot2. As I apply for funding for further ggplot2
development, I'd like to be able to tell reviewers a bit more about
this group, so I'd really appreciate it if you'd complete the first
annual ggplot2 survey:

http://hadley.wufoo.com/forms/ggplot2-survey/

The more people who fill it out, the stronger the case I can make to
funding agencies, so please take a minute or two to add your data!

Thanks,

Hadley
